profile.headline: Chief Software Engineer | Computer Engineering, Mixed Signal I/O, Algorithms, Drivers
profile.summary: Chief Software Engineer at Emerson - Test and Measurement

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheading the design and implementation of cutting-edge privacy compliance tools, ensuring adherence to GDPR and other international privacy regulations. 
• Develop and standardize root cause analysis processes across software development teams, leading to the enhancement of scanning and analysis tools to ensure these issues do not happen again.  
• Coordinate cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative environment that allows for sharing of learnings and prevention of privacy leaks.

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer
positions.description:
Chief Software Engineer, 2020 - 2022
• Productization and technical lead for the Mixed Signal IO domain, including planning and collaboration travel in February 2020.
• Technical lead for projects and features in the NI-DCPower and NI-Digital drivers including teams in Penang, Malaysia.
• Lead developer for high priority features needed for closing sales with key-customer accounts.

Principal Software Engineer, 2015 - 2020
• Technical owner for the pattern based digital program. Stand up a new team of 7 developers with different levels of experience. Define features, mentor, technical lead, code review and supervise the team. Work with management to develop and track the project schedules. Gather requirements from customers and analyze competitor offerings. This program won the NI Innovation of the Year Award in 2017.
• Technical lead for a team of 7 engineers in NI Shanghai, including planning and collaboration travel in October 2019.

Senior Software Engineer, 2007 - 2015
• Design the architecture and infrastructure for being able to remotely debug a system using the InstrumentStudio and Soft Front Panel applications for several drivers in the company. Supervise and review the implementation.
• Expat assignment in Penang Malasia between 2011-2013 to establish a new R&D and manufacturing branch. This involved recruiting, training, mentoring, technical leading and supervising a team of 7 engineers with different levels of experience, as well as interfacing with NI corporate in Austin.
• Manage, mentor and technical lead junior engineers in the HSDIO group.

Staff Software Engineer, 2003 - 2007
• Joint project with Tektronix to introduce a 12GS/s digitizer, including clocking and synchronization infrastructure.
• Design and implement the full stack for the NI-HSDIO Windows driver.
• Add Windows kernel support for the 654x high-speed digital I/O device family.
• Recruiting and interviewing of college graduates.

Software Engineer, 2000 - 2003

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, implementation and testing of SmartARC, a graphical language for automation of the steel melting process.
• Design, implementation and testing of windows drivers to interface SmartARC with Siemens and GE PLCs.
• Develop proprietary software for logging and analyzing data.
• Deployment of SmartARC at melt-shops in Mexico, USA, Germany and South Africa.
